updates.content:
Title: Field Service mobile app users experience intermittent sign-in failures

User impact: Field Service mobile app users experience intermittent sign-in failures.

More Info: Impact is limited to signing-in to new sessions and signing back in to a session after signing out. Users who are already signed are not affected until their cached tokens expire.

Users receive the error message "No network connection. Please check your network settings and try again." upon failure.

As a workaround, we recommend that:
• Use Field Service in a web browser until this is mitigated.
• Users who are still signed in shouldn't sign out, clear app data or reinstall.

Current Status: Our monitoring alerted us to an issue where Field Service mobile app users experience intermittent sign-in failures. Our investigation identified that an internal upstream service dependency, Exchange, which supports the sign-in functionality, is experiencing a service outage. This service outage has caused sign-in requests to intermittently fail at the authorization step. We are monitoring service diagnostics for recovery as actions are performed to mitigate the service outage on Exchange.

Next Update: Friday, November 13, 2026, at 9:00 AM UTC

Title: Field Service mobile app users experience intermittent sign-in failures

User impact: Field Service mobile app users experienced intermittent sign-in failures.

Final Status: The upstream dependency service has recovered. We have confirmed via service diagnostic review that users are no longer experiencing intermittent sign-in failures with the Field Service mobile app. 

A Post Incident Report will be published within five days.

Preliminary Root Cause: A dependency service responsible for authentication was unavailable. 

Next Steps: We’re reviewing our code for improved performance and potential automated recovery options to reduce or avoid similar issues in the future.
